downstreamNotes: Naive Core is a dark-first design system distilled from naive-ui's official dark theme. Tokens are preserved verbatim from the source (e.g. --primaryColor instead of --bg-brand). Components use the .ds-* class prefix and reference tokens directly via var(). UI Kits are showcases (max-width 1184px) — do not copy as page templates; instead, read preview/component-*.html for clean component markup and compose your own outer grid at the consumer canvas size.
